name: Combinatorial Objective Obfuscation
description: Replaces the explicit base-3 positional sum $E = \sum s_i 3^{n-i}$ with an equivalent DAG path-counting problem. Models relying on surface pattern matching will fail to recognize that minimizing paths in this specific DAG is mathematically identical to finding the lexicographically smallest sequence, and will likely TLE by attempting to optimize the DAG globally instead of locally orienting bipartite components.
